name: Afziaka Stalker

items.name: Grave-Bound Guts
items.text: While within 100 feet of its vrykolakas's burial ground, an afziaka appears in the natural shape it had when it was a regular animal and can eat normally. When farther away, it doesn't gain sustenance from eating food and eventually starves to death.

items.name: Hunger Pangs
items.text: A creature damaged by the afziaka's fangs must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude save save or become Enfeebled 2 for 1 hour. The creature can remove this condition earlier by consuming at least a handful of raw meat.

items.name: Slip Between
items.text: The stalker teleports into an occupied space it can see within 50 feet and makes a melee Strike.

text:
Big predatory animals like dire wolves or hyaenodons might survive as an afziaka stalker, magically able to stalk their quarry.

---

Vrykolakas vampires use animals as tools to carry their spirits when they would otherwise be slain. The animal usually dies as the vampire is reborn, but some live on in painful starvation.
